comparison.objective: Insert an emergency-stop button through a keyed panel hole and secure it with a threaded locking ring; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed barrel alignment, through-panel insertion and bimanual rear-side ring threading versus recessed blade insertion beneath a tab and coordinated withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Button flush with tab in notch, ring snug and hands released; candidate requires selected terminal removed without damage or unintended extraction. Candidate exact thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve keyed component retention, but assembly/threading and depinning exercise materially different abilities.
